text: Lin's dad passed away on Sunday. Funeral is next Thursday at the crem, 11am. Remind me to send flowers to her mum the day before.
anya pregnant!! due in march, 2nd one. told me at lunch, shes been really sick with it tho
Pedro got a puppy, a cocker spaniel called Biscuit. Picking her up Saturday. He's buzzing.

So I bumped into Oscar outside the Co-op and he said he's been made redundant, they told the whole team on Monday, and his last day is the end of next week. He's trying to be upbeat about it but you could tell he's pretty rattled, his wife's on maternity leave as well so the timing is awful. Need to send him that recruiter's number and maybe take him for a pint after his last day.

Long chat with Michael after five a side. He and his partner split up about a month ago, she's kept the flat so he's staying at his brother Dafydd's for now, sleeping on the sofa bed. Says he's mostly fine but the weekends are hard. Invite him over for Sunday lunch this weekend.
Oisín's cat Pickle has a lump, vet is doing a biopsy tomorrow morning. Text him tomorrow afternoon to see what they said
Yetunde's christening for baby Tolu is this Sunday, 1pm, St Mark's. I'm doing the cake.
Anika's nan died last week. Funeral was yesterday, she said it was a lovely send off. Seems okay but tired.
note to self: book the dog in for her jabs before we go away friday
Joanna — 16 weeks, scan went fine. Wants to find out the gender at the 20 week one. Loves anything with lemons on it, apparently, which helps for the baby shower later on.
dafydd's rabbit died. kids are gutted. he said they're burying it in the garden this weekend

Akira told me she's expecting twins!! Due in May. She found out at the scan and apparently Kenji just sat on the floor. Her and Kenji are moving to a bigger place in Didsbury the month before, which sounds mad but their flat is tiny. She's been off coffee and is miserable about it. Don't forget to ask her about the next scan on Tuesday.
Francesca's engagement is off, she called it off herself. She seems relieved more than anything. Moving back in with her parents Saturday.
Ebony's dog Rolo turns 10 on Wednesday, she's doing a little party for him lol. Get him a squeaky toy
Duc has been laid off from the warehouse. Has a meeting with HR on Monday about the package. Remind me to ring him that evening.
Juan and Lola had the baby! Little girl, Sofia, born Tuesday night, 7lb 2. Both doing well. Must send a card and maybe a meal voucher next week once they're home.
Darius's grandad is in hospice. Not long left they think. He's flying to Tehran tomorrow.

Voice memo. Okay so Connor rang, his mum's funeral is on the 3rd, Friday, and then the wake is at the Red Lion afterwards. He asked if I could do a reading. I said yes. He's holding up, sort of. His sister Erin is doing most of the arranging because he's not sleeping. I should check in with him the day after, it's always worse once everyone goes home.
Varun's wife had a miscarriage at 10 weeks. He told me in confidence. Take it gently, maybe drop round with food this weekend
katarzyna new kitten!! tabby, called Pierogi. obsessed

Suzanne's cat Mabel is really poorly, kidney failure. They've tried the special diet and the drip but she's stopped eating, so the vet thinks they'll have to put her to sleep next week, probably Wednesday. Suzanne's in bits, she's had Mabel since uni. Her daughter is coming home for it. Send her something nice the day after.
Dalia baby shower Sat 2pm at her sister's. Bring a gift, she's registered at John Lewis, wants the muslin squares
Mihai's leaving do was cancelled, the whole office is being shut. He's been made redundant along with like 30 others. He says he's fine but he's not.
Erin and Tobi have adopted a greyhound, Pip. Retired racer, very shy. They'll have him a fortnight on trial first.
Naledi's waters broke this morning!! Her husband texted from the hospital. Remind me to message her tomorrow, not before.
Tobi failed his redundancy appeal. Last day is next Friday. Wants to go travelling for a bit after.
Agnieszka and her boyfriend broke up on Saturday after six years. She's taking the week off. Caitlin's going round there tonight with wine. I should ring her Wednesday.
caitlin dog had puppies!! 7 of them. she's keeping one, rest go at 8 wks
Lola's mum is having chemo again from next Monday. Lola is driving her every Tuesday and Thursday. Find out if she needs lifts.
Paolo's mother-in-law passed on Wednesday. They're flying out to Naples for the funeral the day after tomorrow, back the week after. Feed their cat Luna while they're gone!
Rafael's divorce finalised this week. Says he feels lighter. New flat in Leith from the 1st.
Pick up the cat's prescription from the vet tomorrow and cancel the groomer on Thursday.

Lin is 30 weeks now and the baby's breech, so she's got another scan on Friday to see if it's turned. If not they'll talk about trying to turn it or booking a section. She's a bit anxious about it all. Her partner Pedro's working away on the rigs until the weekend so her mum is going with her.
Anya mentioned her dog Bramble is going in for a dental on Tuesday. Bramble hates the vet, apparently they have to muzzle her.
Oscar's got his final interview for the council job on Thursday, first one since the redundancy. He's really nervous. Text him good luck that morning.
Michael's sister had her baby last night, a boy, Rhys. He's an uncle for the first time, over the moon.
hurried one - Oisín wife Niamh expecting again, due xmas. dont say anything yet theyre waiting till after the 12wk scan
Yetunde said her mum's anniversary is coming up, five years since she died. She always goes to the grave that day, the 14th. Might be nice to send something the day before.
Anika's cat Mochi is 15 now and still bossing the dog around. She does the cat calendar every year, would love one of Mochi.
Joanna and Dafydd brought the baby round today. Ivy. Six weeks old. Joanna's back at work in January, not looking forward to it.
Akira's mum is in hospital with a broken hip, op is tomorrow. Akira's staying with her the night before. Ask Akira how the op went on Thursday.
Francesca has a new puppy!! A golden retriever, Bear. Puppy classes start Monday evening.

Okay recording this in the car. Ebony's dad died on Friday, completely out of the blue, heart attack. She's flying back to Jamaica on Wednesday for the funeral, which is the following Saturday, and she'll stay another week afterwards to help her mum sort things. She's asked if I can water her plants and pick up her post. I said of course. I need to get her the spare key before Wednesday and send a card to her mum.
Duc's mum has been diagnosed with dementia. He's cutting down to three days a week to help out. Struggling, honestly.
Juan's dog Chico got hit by a car on Sunday, he's in the vet hospital. Leg op tomorrow. Juan's really shaken.
Darius and his girlfriend are expecting! First one, due in June. He's terrified lol. She's craving sour sweets constantly.
Connor's hamster died. He's eight. Sounds like a full funeral in a shoebox happened yesterday afternoon.
varun - redundancy consultation tmrw 10am, then the decision a week after. remind me to call him tmrw night
Katarzyna's christening for Zofia is in a fortnight, Sunday the 2nd. She asked me to be godmother!! Need to find out what a godmother actually does.
Suzanne mentioned she's been grieving her old dog Max a lot lately, even though it was two years ago. Wants to get another dog but her husband isn't keen.

Dalia's grandmother passed on Monday, she was 94. Funeral is Friday at the mosque and then the burial straight afterwards, and the family are hosting people at her uncle's all weekend. Dalia said she's more worried about her mum than herself. Text her Friday night and maybe take her for breakfast the week after.
Mihai and Agnieszka are having a baby! Due in April. Mihai's already bought a tiny Arsenal kit.
Erin's driving test is next Wednesday, third attempt, and she's dreading it. Her brother Connor is taking her out for practice this weekend.
Dog walker cancelled for tomorrow, need to come home at lunch.
Naledi's cat Simba went missing on Saturday. She's put posters up. Ask her if he's turned up when I see her Tuesday.

Tobi's partner Lola lost her job on Friday, the café she managed closed with a day's notice and no redundancy pay. They're worried about rent because Tobi's only part time while he finishes his course. She's job hunting already and has a trial shift at a bakery on Thursday. Tobi says she loves baking anyway so fingers crossed.
Agnieszka Nowak, Aga to everyone, from the antenatal class — her baby boy arrived on Friday! Name's Leo. Remind me to drop off the hand-me-downs this weekend.
Rang Caitlin. Her gran's funeral got moved to Monday because the vicar's ill. The wake at her aunt's house is still on afterwards.
Paolo's daughter graduated nursery today, he sent about 40 photos. Big school in September.
Pay the vet bill, renew the pet insurance, and order more cat food before Friday.
